code_facts: The command looks up the Utility named object DataTypesList and dereferences the returned NamedObject's no_Object pointer at code offset 0x59c.
The built-in registration path computes list addresses from that object at byte offsets 0x2e, 0x3c, 0x4a, 0x58 and 0x66.
The four named built-ins binary, ascii, iff and directory are associated with offsets 0x3c, 0x4a, 0x58 and 0x66; the preceding 0x2e head is the global sorted-list head used by the registration path.

Directory registration reads and writes a longword at offset 0x78 from the shared-list pointer at code offsets 0xa26 and 0xa36. After saving a register, the same stack argument is used at 0xa48 to derive the sorted-list head at offset 0x2e, binding the 0x78 access to DataTypesList.

In the matched-descriptor registration helper, a3 is the candidate descriptor passed by the scanner; code stores the computed mask byte-count at descriptor offset 62 and the allocated mask pointer at offset 66 (code offsets 0x07d8 and 0x07e8).

The same descriptor helper stores the allocated DTCD bytes pointer and byte-count at offsets 70 and 74, the loader result and its function-entry pointer at offsets 78 and 82 (code offsets 0x0982, 0x099e, 0x09e6 and 0x09f4), and tests offset 86 before replacement (code offset 0x085a).

The DTHD parse path allocates the candidate with its embedded header at +90, stores that header address in the descriptor at +28, and stores a computed size value at +54 (code offsets 0x0db0, 0x0dcc, 0x0dd2 and 0x0e34). The built-in path allocates strlen(name)+123 bytes, starts its embedded 32-byte header at +90 and trailing name storage at +122 (code offsets 0x11b0, 0x11d0 and 0x11d8).

observed_shared_list_fields.pointer_binding: The same incoming shared-list pointer is used after one saved register to derive the confirmed sorted list at +0x2e.

evidence_limits: Offsets are static observations from the hash-bound Workbench AddDataTypes command and companion library binary. They confirm five DataTypesList heads, one refresh-date longword, and the listed candidate CompoundDatatype field offsets in command code.

The longest-mask field, complete DataTypesList size, SignalSemaphore ownership, node ownership/lifetime, all descriptor-field semantics, sorting details and concurrency behavior are not fully established by this capture. The +54 size field and +14 secondary-node role retain provisional semantic labels.
No command execution on an authentic Workbench guest, output comparison or shipping/PURE/resident admission is claimed. The Workbench command observations do not close the MorphOS 3.20 library ABI.
